title: SoMe Age restrictions - evaluation, Australia 2026
discussion_signal: The post shares an early evaluation suggesting that many under-16s retained social-media access three months after Australia's age restrictions began. Its discussion frames a gap between policy intent, platform age-assurance implementation, and lived outcomes, while also noting that wider family, school, and community conversation may itself shift norms.
linked_research_question: When a public institution changes access to a cultural technology, do platform implementation and lived adaptation produce the intended social outcome?
limits: LinkedIn post summarizes an evaluation rather than providing the underlying sample or methods
Platform search does not expose the full discussion context
One early evaluation cannot establish long-run effects or causality
